title: clip art
explanation:
### Description

Create extruded clip art from a beach photograph by thresholding, seed connectivity, smoothing, clipping, decimating, and extruding the resulting geometry with texture mapping.

**dataset → input → filter → dataset → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCastToConcrete](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCastToConcrete.html) — casts abstract data objects to their concrete types.
- [vtkClipPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkClipPolyData.html) — clips polygonal data with an implicit function.
- [vtkDecimatePro](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDecimatePro.html) — reduces the number of triangles in a mesh.
- [vtkImageConstantPad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageConstantPad.html) — pads an image with a constant value.
- [vtkImageDataGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageDataGeometryFilter.html) — converts image data to polygonal geometry.
- [vtkImageExtractComponents](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageExtractComponents.html) — extracts selected components from multi-component image data.
- [vtkImageGaussianSmooth](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageGaussianSmooth.html) — smooths an image with a Gaussian kernel.
- [vtkImageRGBToHSV](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageRGBToHSV.html) — converts RGB image data to HSV color space.
- [vtkImageSeedConnectivity](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSeedConnectivity.html) — identifies connected regions in a binary image from seed points.
- [vtkImageShrink3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageShrink3D.html) — subsamples an image by averaging neighboring voxels.
- [vtkImageThreshold](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageThreshold.html) — thresholds an image, replacing values inside/outside a range.
- [vtkLinearExtrusionFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLinearExtrusionFilter.html) — extrudes polygonal data along a direction.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolyDataNormals](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataNormals.html) — computes surface normals for smooth shading.
- [vtkStripper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStripper.html) — creates triangle strips and/or polylines from polygonal data.
- [vtkTIFFReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFReader.html) — reads TIFF image files.
- [vtkTexture](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexture.html) — applies a texture image to geometry.
- [vtkTextureMapToPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextureMapToPlane.html) — generates texture coordinates by projecting onto a plane.
- [vtkTriangleFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTriangleFilter.html) — converts polygons into triangles.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
